mapping.summary: Imports Excel and CSV files into tables via staging journal
claims: Imports Excel (.xlsx) and CSV files into any BC table without development
Configurable: CSV separator, text encoding, caption row and header rows
Multi-table targets in one batch such as sales header and lines from one file
Existing-record handling: skip, modify or error
Field mappings with fixed values, filters, priorities and date formats
Value and enum mappings translate source codes to BC values
Staging journal to review and correct rows before processing, with row-level errors
New from File wizard infers columns, data types and proposes mappings with confidence scores
Import templates cover general journal, purchase order and sales order
Template export as empty file for users to fill in
Integrates with the BC change log
